correctness.rationale: Stationary beta/Gaussian convolution is derived from the coupled forward equations. Kummer ODE gives H’=(h-1)I/z at every zero, so all zero crossings have the same sign and the opposite endpoint signs force uniqueness. A strict Gaussian-kernel ratio monotonicity controls the number of derivative zeros on the positive half-line, extending local curvature to a global mode classification. Likelihood-ratio stochastic ordering proves strict phase-curve monotonicity and the beta and uniform endpoint limits. Standalone finite checks passed; infinite claims use the analytical proof.
